(define (square x) (* x x))
(define (cube x) (* x x x))
(define (average x y) (/ (+ x y) 2))
(define (inc x) (+ x 1))
(define (dec x) (- x 1))
(define true #t)
(define false #f)
records.context: 下面集中给出阅读所用基本过程的等价定义；inc、dec 分别加一、减一，true、false 是布尔值名字。这些是题设的基本操作约定；完整运行源另有数值保护。

records.title: 原始平方根与停止测试
records.code:
(define (sqrt-iter guess x)
  (if (good-enough? guess x)
      guess
      (sqrt-iter (improve guess x) x)))

(define (improve guess x)
  (average guess (/ x guess)))

(define (good-enough? guess x)
  (< (abs (- (square guess) x)) 0.001))

(define (sqrt x)
  (sqrt-iter 1.0 x))
records.context: 此处是原书的绝对残差版本，供1.6—1.8和1.46引用；依赖前面的square、average。其零值、尺度与浮点局限在1.7另行修改，不能把此版本当作改进版。

records.title: Fibonacci 的递归定义
records.context: 下标为非负整数，起始值为0和1，后续项为前两项之和。黄金比例是φ=(1+√5)/2；1.13将从该递推证明闭式。

records.title: Fibonacci 的状态迭代
records.code:
(define (fib n)
  (fib-iter 1 0 n))

(define (fib-iter a b count)
  (if (= count 0)
      b
      (fib-iter (+ a b) a (- count 1))))
records.context: 这是替代上一个fib定义的另一版本，不把两个同名定义并列装进一个模块。初态(a,b)=(1,0)，每步同时更新为(a+b,a)。

records.title: count-change 的完整输入
records.code:
(define (count-change amount)
  (cc amount 5))

(define (cc amount kinds-of-coins)
  (cond ((= amount 0) 1)
        ((or (< amount 0)
             (= kinds-of-coins 0))
         0)
        (else
         (+ (cc amount (- kinds-of-coins 1))
            (cc (- amount (first-denomination
                           kinds-of-coins))
                kinds-of-coins)))))

(define (first-denomination kinds-of-coins)
  (cond ((= kinds-of-coins 1) 1)
        ((= kinds-of-coins 2) 5)
        ((= kinds-of-coins 3) 10)
        ((= kinds-of-coins 4) 25)
        ((= kinds-of-coins 5) 50)))
records.context: 固定五种面额，amount为整数、kinds-of-coins在0—5内；金额为零先于无面额分支判断。习题1.14的全部调用树以这一定义为准。

records.title: 递归 fast-expt
records.code:
(define (fast-expt b n)
  (cond ((= n 0)
         1)
        ((even? n)
         (square (fast-expt b (/ n 2))))
        (else
         (* b (fast-expt b (- n 1))))))
records.context: 这里的指数为非负整数。square只求一次半指数结果；1.16把同一目标改为迭代，1.25比较完整求幂与逐步取模。

records.title: 原始试除检验
records.code:
(define (smallest-divisor n)
  (find-divisor n 2))

(define (find-divisor n test-divisor)
  (cond ((> (square test-divisor) n)
         n)
        ((divides? test-divisor n)
         test-divisor)
        (else (find-divisor
               n
               (+ test-divisor 1)))))

(define (divides? a b)
  (= (remainder b a) 0))

(define (prime? n)
  (= n (smallest-divisor n)))
records.context: 原书这段prime?以整数n≥2为使用前提，不能拿它把1判为素数。独立执行源显式拒绝n<2，并允许替换候选因子的后继。

records.title: expmod 与 Fermat 多轮检验
records.code:
(define (expmod base exp m)
  (cond ((= exp 0) 1)
        ((even? exp)
         (remainder
          (square (expmod base (/ exp 2) m))
          m))
        (else
         (remainder
          (* base (expmod base (- exp 1) m))
          m))))

(define (fermat-test n)
  (define (try-it a)
    (= (expmod a n n) a))
  (try-it (+ 1 (random (- n 1)))))

(define (fast-prime? n times)
  (cond ((= times 0) true)
        ((fermat-test n)
         (fast-prime? n (- times 1)))
        (else false)))
records.context: n为整数且至少为2，指数非负，模数为正；random(m)产生0至m−1中的整数。源中times=0返回true仅表示没有剩余检验，不提供素性证据。脚注1.47列出的Carmichael数为561、1105、1729、2465、2821、6601。
records.original_code:
(define (expmod base exp m)
  (cond ((= exp 0) 1)
        ((even? exp)
         (remainder 
          (square (expmod base (/ exp 2) m))
          m))
        (else
         (remainder 
          (* base (expmod base (- exp 1) m))
          m))))

(define (fermat-test n)
  (define (try-it a)
    (= (expmod a n n) a))
  (try-it (+ 1 (random (- n 1)))))

(define (fast-prime? n times)
  (cond ((= times 0) true)
        ((fermat-test n) 
         (fast-prime? n (- times 1)))
        (else false)))

records.title: 原始 sum
records.code:
(define (sum term a next b)
  (if (> a b)
      0
      (+ (term a)
         (sum term (next a) next b))))
records.context: 空区间返回0；term给出当前项，next给出后继。用于有限数值区间时，后继须推进到越过终点。

records.title: 原始 fixed-point
records.code:
(define tolerance 0.00001)

(define (fixed-point f first-guess)
  (define (close-enough? v1 v2)
    (< (abs (- v1 v2))
       tolerance))
  (define (try guess)
    (let ((next (f guess)))
      (if (close-enough? guess next)
          next
          (try next))))
  (try first-guess))
records.context: 此版本比较绝对步差，返回下一猜测；没有最大步数保护。习题1.36保留同一阈值比较轨迹，运行适配另设上限。

records.title: 数值导数与 Newton 变换
records.code:
(define (deriv g)
  (lambda (x)
    (/ (- (g (+ x dx)) (g x))
       dx)))

(define dx 0.00001)

(define (newton-transform g)
  (lambda (x)
    (- x (/ (g x)
            ((deriv g) x)))))

(define (newtons-method g guess)
  (fixed-point (newton-transform g)
               guess))
records.context: 依赖前面的fixed-point；dx是差分步长，与停止容差角色不同。此教材输入没有处理零导数；执行参考源明确报错，避免除零。
